nodes.name: New email in Install Requests
nodes.notes: SET THE FOLDER: open this node and choose Install Requests.

nodes.name: Send to dispatch
nodes.notes: PASTE YOUR KEY: replace PASTE_YOUR_AUTOMATION_API_KEY_HERE in the Authorization header.

nodes.name: Move to Processed
nodes.notes: SET THE FOLDER: choose Install Requests/Processed. This only runs when the send above succeeded, so a failed email stays in the inbox for another try.
